title.zh-CN: 反复旋转性头晕 4 年 · 49岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 围绕反复旋转性头晕 4 年，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for recurrent spinning dizziness for four years.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 将头晕细化为旋转性眩晕及时间模式。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别影像异常与症状因果的区别。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免把阴性检查扩大为全部排除。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 讨论颈部操作前安全评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Discuss safety assessment before cervical procedures.

text.zh-CN: Dix–Hallpike 阴性，未引出自发眼震，双侧水平半规管功能正常；早期电测听正常，后续部分耳声发射异常。
text.en: Dix–Hallpike was negative, without spontaneous nystagmus; horizontal canal function and initial audiometry were normal, with later partial otoacoustic-emission abnormalities.

text.zh-CN: 左丘脑陈旧小腔隙灶；MRA、MRV 及 TCD 未见主要血流异常。
text.en: An old small left thalamic lacune; MRA, MRV and TCD showed no major flow abnormality.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 寰枢间隙左右不对称，C3–C6 轻度椎间盘突出、无髓内异常；原骨科诊断颈椎病及寰枢关节半脱位。
text.en: Asymmetric atlantoaxial spaces and mild C3–C6 disc protrusion without cord signal change; the original orthopaedic diagnosis was cervical disease with atlantoaxial subluxation.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 原报告在颈部小针刀、手法复位及贴敷 4 次后，1 个月症状明显好转、开口位片更对称；这些是历史观察，不构成此类操作的普遍推荐或病因证明。
text.en: After four sessions of needle-knife, manipulation and topical treatment, the source reported improvement at one month and more symmetric open-mouth radiographs. These observations do not establish causation or endorse these procedures generally.

hint.zh-CN: 从起病、演变及伴随症状寻找关键信息。
hint.en: Clarify onset, progression and associated symptoms.

hint.zh-CN: 区分患者叙述、查体记录和辅助检查报告。
hint.en: Distinguish the history, examination record and investigation reports.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。
hint.en: Identify supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and remaining gaps.

hint.zh-CN: 将报告结局与当时可获得的证据分开。
hint.en: Separate the reported outcome from evidence available at the decision point.

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 反复眩晕与颈部异常共存，但颈源因果尚未确立
text.en: Recurrent vertigo and cervical abnormalities coexist, but cervical causation is unproven

feedback.zh-CN: 结构异常并非眩晕病因的特异证据。
feedback.en: Structural findings are not specific proof of vertigo causation.

text.zh-CN: 颈椎影像异常已经证明椎动脉受压
text.en: Cervical imaging proves vertebral-artery compression

feedback.zh-CN: 未给动态血管受压证据。
feedback.en: Dynamic vascular compression was not demonstrated.

text.zh-CN: 血管影像正常排除全部中枢病因
text.en: Normal vascular imaging excludes every central cause

feedback.zh-CN: 检查范围不能支持绝对排除。
feedback.en: The tests do not support absolute exclusion.

prompt.zh-CN: 下一步最安全的思路是什么？
prompt.en: What is the safest next approach?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 重新按发作时间、诱因、偏头痛及听力线索评估，颈部操作前先核对安全
text.en: Reassess timing, triggers, migraine and hearing clues and review safety before cervical procedures

feedback.zh-CN: 需避免单一影像锚定和未经评估的操作。
feedback.en: Avoid anchoring on one image or unassessed manipulation.

text.zh-CN: 立即照搬小针刀和强力复位
text.en: Immediately copy needle-knife treatment and forceful manipulation

feedback.zh-CN: 单例不足以证明收益及个体安全。
feedback.en: One case does not establish benefit or individual safety.

text.zh-CN: 没有听力丧失就排除所有前庭病
text.en: No hearing loss excludes all vestibular disorders

feedback.zh-CN: 许多前庭病不要求听力丧失。
feedback.en: Many vestibular disorders do not require hearing loss.

prompt.zh-CN: 治疗后症状好转能否确证病因？
prompt.en: Can improvement after treatment confirm the cause?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 不能，主观改善与影像变化不能单独证明颈部病因
text.en: No: subjective improvement and imaging change alone do not establish cervical causation

feedback.zh-CN: Bárány 2022 明确指出这种推断的证据限制。
feedback.en: The Bárány 2022 position identifies this evidential limitation.

text.zh-CN: 好转即证明所有头晕来自寰枢关节
text.en: Improvement proves every symptom arose from the atlantoaxial joint

feedback.zh-CN: 存在自然波动及非特异治疗效应。
feedback.en: Natural fluctuation and nonspecific effects remain possible.

text.zh-CN: 一个月好转证明永久治愈
text.en: One month of improvement proves permanent cure

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原文认为颈性眩晕，但现代证据要求保留机制不确定性；本教学重点是避免影像锚定与危险求证。
conclusion.en: The source attributed dizziness to the neck, but contemporary evidence requires mechanistic uncertainty; the teaching focus is avoiding imaging anchoring and unsafe confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 眩晕的时程与诱因比笼统“头晕”更有信息。
keyReasoning.en: Timing and triggers are more informative than the broad label “dizziness”.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: Bárány 2022 未支持以颈部异常直接建立旋转性眩晕因果。
keyReasoning.en: Bárány 2022 does not support directly inferring vertigo causation from neck abnormalities.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗反应不是独立病因试验。
keyReasoning.en: Treatment response is not an independent aetiological test.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整前庭性偏头痛标准、动态血管评价、可靠长随访未载。
unknowns.en: Full vestibular-migraine criteria, dynamic vascular assessment and reliable long-term follow-up are absent.
